question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A deal of agreement done in a company or firm.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Contract"** means a formal agreement between two or more parties, especially one enforceable by law. (अनुबंध)

 
 
• **Example: **The company signed a **contract **with a new supplier.
 
 
 
• **"Contract" **refers to a binding agreement or deal made in a business context. (अनुबंध)
 
 
• **Example: **The** contract **stipulated the terms and conditions of the partnership.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given statement is **Contract**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Concurrence **(सहमति): Agreement in opinion or decision.

 
 
• **Example:** The board reached a **concurrence** on the new policy.
 
 
 
• **Acceptance **(स्वीकृति): The action of consenting to receive or undertake something offered.
 
 
• **Example: **Her** acceptance **of the job offer was immediate.
 
 
 
• **Conformity** (अनुरूपता): Compliance with standards, rules, or laws.
 
 
• **Example:** The product was in **conformity** with all safety regulations.
